title: Gemini cost up over 4x and latency up after the prompt refactor
scenario: After release 2026.10.06 the nightly CM-03 batch costs about $0.30 per 100 samples instead of $0.08 and p50 latency went from 180 to 830 ms. The release also bumped the model to gemini-3.8-flash-002 and added a second Function instance, and the team suspects the model. You get per-call usage logs before and after, the dashboard, the release notes and a fake Gemini endpoint that simulates implicit caching.
task: Explain why cached_content_token_count is 0 on every call after the release
Compare serialized requests across samples and across processes with different hash seeds
Rule the model bump in or out with evidence
Fix the request builder so the static prefix is byte-stable; verify with make replay
acceptance: Tools plus system prefix identical across samples, runs and PYTHONHASHSEED values
Per-request data only in the last user content; request contract unchanged
Cache hit ratio about 0.9 again across two instances; cost and latency back to baseline
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected faults
